## Core Agency Services
1. **Custom Web Application Development**
   - Modern React 19, Next.js, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
   - 99+ Google Lighthouse & Core Web Vitals compliance.
   - Clean, modular codebases with full source code handoff.

2. **Headless Shopify & E-Commerce Systems**
   - High-converting product catalogs, mobile-first checkout flows.
   - Stripe, Wise, local Pakistani payment gateway integrations.
   - Real-time multi-currency pricing converter.

3. **Enterprise WordPress & CMS Architecture**
   - Lightweight, bloat-free custom WordPress theme engineering.
   - Security hardening against SQL injections and brute force attacks.
   - Headless WP REST API integrations.

4. **Technical SEO & Search Visibility Architecture**
   - JSON-LD Structured Data Schema (Organization, WebSite, ProfessionalService, FAQPage).
   - Core Web Vitals performance tuning (LCP < 1.2s, CLS < 0.05, INP < 100ms).
   - Semantic HTML5 structure, sitemap indexing, and search console optimization.

5. **UI/UX Product Design & Prototyping**
   - High-fidelity Figma design systems and interactive 3D mockups.
   - Conversion-rate-optimized (CRO) user journeys.

6. **Web Hosting, Domain Management & Care Plans**
   - Enterprise DNS setup, SSL encryption certificates.
   - Automated backups, uptime monitoring, and ongoing monthly maintenance.

## Technical Guarantees & Terms
- **100% Intellectual Property Ownership:** Full source code and asset handoff to the client upon completion.
- **Signed Mutual NDA:** Complete data privacy and commercial protection.
- **B2B Milestone Terms:** Standard 50% upfront deposit upon sprint kickoff, 50% upon final production sign-off.
- **Live Client Milestone Tracker:** Real-time milestone verification portal for authorized clients.
